payload.title: Review TASK-814
Run-as/audit: _write_with_run_as degrades to non-transactional when conn lacks transaction/commit/rollback
payload.body: querysource/repositories/definitions.py::_write_with_run_as uses getattr for transaction/commit/rollback and skips missing ones (done to keep mock-based tests passing). On a connection without them, FOR UPDATE/SAVEPOINT run in autocommit and the definition write can commit without its audit row. Require these methods (update test mocks), and guard rollback so it cannot mask the original error.

payload.title: Run-as attribution fail-open: sessionless/failed-session schedule change or removal keeps previous run-as user
payload.body: handlers/manager.py::_run_as_context swallows session errors silently (actor=None); definitions.py::_apply_run_as with actor None leaves old scheduler_run_as_user_id in place even when the schedule is changed/removed (confused-deputy risk). Log session failures, clear run-as on schedule removal, consider refusing unattributed schedule changes. Also: fallback warning for un-migrated store fires every write, not once per store.

Semantic catalog endpoint uses wrong driver/dialect and skips datasource:use
payload.body: querysource/handlers/semantic.py (SemanticCatalog.catalog) derives the driver from model.dwh_driver/driver/'pg' instead of the datasource named in resource.connection, so non-Postgres models report dialect=postgres and a model_version that can differ from the provider's. It also never calls governance.enforce_datasource, exposing metadata of a datasource the user may not use. Fix: resolve the datasource like semanticProvider._resolve_datasource and enforce datasource:use/driver:use.

payload.title: describe_slug derived.semantic leaks connection, roles and parse errors to non-raw callers
payload.body: querysource/queries/describe.py builds _semantic_summary from unredacted query_raw after redaction, exposing datasource name, governance role names and YAML error text to users without the RAW_FIELDS grant. test_describe_semantic_derived uses raw=True so redaction is untested. Fix: gate derived.semantic on grants.raw (or omit connection/roles/error text) and test with a non-raw grant.

payload.title: Semantic layer test gaps: catalog endpoint, governance filters, AC-12/16/17/21/23/26
payload.body: Review of FEAT-175 found tests that do not assert behaviour: tests/handlers/test_semantic_catalog.py never exercises the real handler/routes (AC-16 401/404/200, AC-26 redaction untested); governance row filters reaching SQL and bad governance filter 500 (AC-12) untested end to end; driver:use (AC-21), cache key with model_version via QS.query (AC-17), path-backed file edit changing the key (AC-23), 501 over HTTP (AC-3) untested; filters tests lack unknown column/command/max_filters cases; the MultiQS no-principal test runs a plain QS. Postgres e2e is opt-in so no CI evidence.

payload.title: Semantic loader: blocking I/O, hash/load race, non-atomic inline write, leaked paths in 400 bodies
payload.body: querysource/semantic/loader.py does sync read_bytes/tempfile writes in async paths; model bytes are hashed in resolve() but re-read by load_from_file later (model_version can mismatch); _write_inline is not atomic (use temp + os.replace). SemanticResourceError messages in compilers/sidemantic.py and providers/semantic.py include raw exception text/paths; log detail and return a generic message. Also providers/semantic.py uses private QueryConnection._default_driver/_dsn; RemoteExecutor logs lack of principal propagation at debug only (make warning); anonymous callers skip role-restricted row filters when PBAC is off (document).
